novel_features.name: Consensus engine
novel_features.description: Answer 'what does the evidence say about X' with a Consensus Score, Confidence Score, and Evidence Strength across all sources.
novel_features.rationale: No single API returns a consensus verdict; requires classifying each study's stance and weighting by evidence tier across a normalized local corpus.
novel_features.example: scientific-consensus consensus "vitamin D reduces respiratory infections" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs an evidence-backed yes/no/mixed verdict instead of a raw paper list.

novel_features.name: Evidence engine + pyramid
novel_features.description: Classify retrieved studies by design (meta-analysis to case report) and render the evidence pyramid for a topic.
novel_features.rationale: OpenAlex type is too coarse; real classification cascades PubMed pubtype -> Semantic Scholar -> title/abstract heuristics, only possible by joining sources locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to judge whether a claim rests on RCTs/meta-analyses or just case series.

novel_features.name: Claim comparison
novel_features.description: Run two consensus analyses side-by-side to compare competing claims or interventions.
novel_features.rationale: Requires two consensus passes over one local store and a normalized diff; no incumbent compares claims head-to-head.
novel_features.example: scientific-consensus compare "statins reduce mortality" "statins increase diabetes risk" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent must weigh two interventions or contradictory claims.

novel_features.name: Research gap detector
novel_features.description: Identify understudied populations, missing long-term/replication/RCT studies, and future directions for a topic.
novel_features.rationale: Requires cross-tabulating study designs, recency, and populations over the local corpus.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to find what research is missing, not just what exists.

novel_features.name: Controversy detector
novel_features.description: Surface conflicting studies, contradictory conclusions, and rapidly changing evidence for a topic.
novel_features.rationale: Requires detecting opposing stances and evidence churn across many works in one pass.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when the question is 'is this settled or disputed?'

novel_features.name: Emerging topics
novel_features.description: Detect the fastest-growing research areas and exploding publication trends.
novel_features.rationale: Requires publication-velocity analysis over topic counts in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to spot hot research areas before they peak.

novel_features.name: Topic drift
novel_features.description: Compare a field's topic distribution between two year windows to spot emerging and fading subtopics.
novel_features.rationale: Requires comparing topic histograms across two time windows from the local corpus.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to see how a field's focus shifted over time.

novel_features.name: Reproducibility signals
novel_features.description: Estimate reproducibility by detecting replication studies, sample sizes, and pre-registration cues.
novel_features.rationale: Requires scanning abstracts across sources for replication/registration signals joined in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to gauge how well-replicated a finding is.

novel_features.name: Study quality estimate
novel_features.description: Estimate overall study quality from design, venue prestige, sample-size cues, and citation mass.
novel_features.rationale: Requires combining signals that only coexist after normalizing multiple sources locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this for a quick quality signal before deep reading.

novel_features.name: Funding analysis
novel_features.description: Analyze funding patterns and funder concentration for a research topic.
novel_features.rationale: Requires Crossref funder data joined with works in the local store; no search tool surfaces funder concentration.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to see who funds research on a topic (potential conflicts).

novel_features.name: Topic watch
novel_features.description: Monitor a topic and report major new publications since the last run.
novel_features.rationale: Requires persisting a baseline snapshot locally and diffing against fresh results on re-run.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this to keep an agent or researcher current on a fast-moving topic.

narrative.headline: Aggregate PubMed, OpenAlex, Crossref, and Europe PMC into evidence summaries, consensus scores, and study-design pyramids no single search tool produces.
narrative.value_prop: Scientific Consensus turns large collections of papers into actionable evidence. It scores consensus across sources (`consensus`), classifies studies by design and renders evidence pyramids (`evidence`), detects gaps and controversies, and persists everything to a local SQLite store you can query offline with `--json`. Fully keyless; optional AI keys upgrade summarization.
narrative.auth_narrative: No API key required for any command. Optional env vars raise limits or enable AI summarization: NCBI_API_KEY (PubMed, higher rate limit), SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY (Semantic Scholar enrichment), and OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY (enhanced summarization). Everything works without them.

quickstart.comment: Verify per-source reachability before running analyses.
Cross-source search to confirm data flows.

quickstart.command: scientific-consensus consensus "vitamin D reduces respiratory infections"
quickstart.comment: The headline command: an evidence-backed consensus verdict.
See the evidence pyramid for the same topic.

troubleshoots.symptom: Semantic Scholar results missing or sparse
troubleshoots.fix: Semantic Scholar rate-limits keyless requests (HTTP 429). Set SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY or rely on OpenAlex/PubMed/Europe PMC; commands degrade gracefully.
Set NCBI_API_KEY to raise the rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second.
Stance classification is lexical without an AI key. Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY for AI-assisted stance detection.
Run 'scientific-consensus sync "<topic>"' first to populate the local store, or use --data-source live.

narrative.when_to_use: Use Scientific Consensus when an agent or researcher needs to know what the evidence says about a claim, not just find papers. It is the right tool for evidence synthesis, consensus scoring, study-design classification, gap/controversy detection, and topic monitoring across biomedical and general scientific literature. It excels when offline persistence and agent-native JSON matter.
anti_triggers: Do not use for retrieving the full text PDF of a specific paper (use the publisher or Europe PMC full-text directly).
Do not use for non-scholarly web search or news.
Do not use as a citation manager replacement for writing (use Zotero); it exports BibTeX but does not manage libraries.
Do not treat heuristic consensus/quality scores as peer-reviewed conclusions.
